userStories.name: Publish Vertex graph CRUD OpenAPI contract
userStories.description: Document the live Vertex SystemGraph create/read/update routes and remove their temporary undocumented-route exceptions so workspace clients can discover the primary graph lifecycle contract.
bdd_acceptance: Given `pkg/vertex/graphsvc/handler.go` registers POST `/api/vertex/v1/graphs`, GET `/api/vertex/v1/graphs/{rid}`, and PUT `/api/vertex/v1/graphs/{rid}`, When the server contract test compares chi routes against `api/openapi.yaml`, Then those three operations are present in the spec and are not allow-listed as undocumented.

Given `createRequest`, `updateRequest`, and `Graph` define the live wire shape, When the OpenAPI contract is parsed, Then `VertexGraphCreateRequest` exposes `ontologyRid`, `name`, optional `versioned`, optional `payload`, and optional `createdBy`, `VertexGraphUpdateRequest` exposes required `payload`, and all three operations use the existing `VertexGraph` response schema.
Given the running server serves the embedded OpenAPI copy from `cmd/server/openapi_spec.yaml`, When embedded-spec drift is checked, Then it remains byte-identical to `api/openapi.yaml`.

bdd_acceptance: Given `pkg/vertex/graphsvc/handler.go` registers duplicate, save-as-template, history, version, and instantiate routes, When the contract test walks chi routes, Then those operations are present in OpenAPI and removed from the undocumented allow-list.

Given graph version rows and template save/instantiate handlers have concrete response/request shapes, When the OpenAPI schema is parsed, Then schemas describe graph history entries, template save responses, and instantiate requests/responses without relying on opaque undocumented behavior.
Given `cmd/server/openapi_spec.yaml` is the runtime served spec, When embedded-spec drift is checked, Then it matches the canonical spec byte-for-byte.

userStories.name: Publish Vertex graph layout and diff OpenAPI contract

Given layout patches accept `positions` and diff requests require `from`/`to` version query parameters, When the OpenAPI schema is parsed, Then request/query parameters and success response schemas describe the live wire contract.
